title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Announced
content: The timetable for Semester 3 mid-semester theory examinations has been published on the student notice board and portal.

title: TechFest 2026 Hackathon Registration Open
content: Registrations are now open for the 36-hour annual national level hackathon 'TechPulse 2026' organized by CSPIT IT.

title: Library Extended Hours for Exam Preparation
content: The central library reading rooms will remain open until 11:00 PM on all working days starting next week.

title: Industrial Visit to GIFT City Tech Park
content: Third semester IT students are eligible to enroll for the one-day industrial exposure visit to GIFT City FinTech hub.

title: Workshop on Cloud Computing & DevOps
content: Hands-on workshop covering Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS deployment will be conducted this Saturday by industry alumni.

title: Hostel Fee Payment Deadline Reminder
content: Hostel residents must clear their term maintenance dues on or before October 5 to avoid late fee penalties.

title: National Cyber Security Awareness Month
content: Join expert guest webinars and cyber security quizzes organized every Wednesday throughout October.

title: Inter-College Cricket Tournament Trials
content: Trials for the FTE cricket squad will take place at the university sports complex cricket ground from 4:30 PM.

title: Scholarship Application Portal Open for 2026-27
content: Merit-cum-means scholarship applications are open for undergraduate students with family income criteria.

title: AI & Deep Learning Research Seminar
content: Keynote address by Dr. K. Mehta on foundation models and medical image diagnosis in the auditorium.

title: Blood Donation Camp by NSS Volunteer Cell
content: CHARUSAT NSS unit is hosting a voluntary blood donation drive in collaboration with the Red Cross Society.

title: Campus Placement Drive for 2026 Batch
content: Leading technology recruiters have commenced initial aptitude screening rounds for final year engineering students.

title: WDF Practical Assignment 2 Submission Due
content: Submit responsive CSS grid layouts and accessible HTML files on GitHub classroom before 11:59 PM.

title: Robotics Club Bootcamp - Arduino to ROS
content: Intensive weekend robotics bootcamp covering embedded sensors, microcontrollers, and ROS navigation.

title: Annual Cultural Fest Auditions Announced
content: Auditions for music, dance, theatre, and fine arts events for Spandan 2026 will be held starting Monday.

title: End-Term Project Synopsis Evaluation
content: All project groups must upload their approved synopsis signed by their respective project guide.
